## Automated Test Requirements

Colocated Vitest files beside each module (this repo has no `tests/` tree). The suite must run green **at `41febe7`**: smoke 2026-10-13 recorded 770/770 at that revision. Re-run in a clean worktree of `41febe7` during Phase 5 so the result is not taken from the dirty tree.

## Manual QA Scope

WN-012, WN-013, WN-014, WN-017, WN-018. Each is walked against its checklist in the 2026-10-12 plan in a clean worktree of `41febe7` (`npm run dev -- --strictPort`, port 4200, 1280×720). Screenshots go to `production/qa/evidence/[story-slug]/`. Evidence artifact per story: `production/qa/evidence/[story-slug]-evidence.md` from `.claude/docs/templates/test-evidence.md`. Sign-off rows stay unchecked unless the sign-off happens.

Test cases: `production/qa/test-cases/wn-0NN-*-cases.md` (Phase 4).

## Out of Scope

- The globe work (no story ID; not in sprint-002). It needs its own story, acceptance criteria and unit coverage for the Scan contract filter now in `WorldMap.tsx`, then its own smoke + QA.
- GDD open questions: Intel-1 stall, locked offers counting toward the 3-offer cap, unnamed Control range, arrival-failure feedback.
- Failed-screen locked contract copy `REQUIRES INTEL LVL 1` (open WN-018 copy question, not a defect against current criteria).

## Entry Criteria

1. Smoke report PASS or PASS WITH WARNINGS exists: `production/qa/smoke-2026-10-13.md`, PASS at `41febe7`. Recorded as PASS WITH WARNINGS because the working tree has changed since; valid for the scoped build.
2. Build is stable: `npm run build` exit 0 and launch to main menu at `41febe7` (smoke paths 1–2).
3. All Must Have stories (WN-005, 008, 009, 010, 011, 018) are `done` in `production/sprint-status.yaml`. Met.
4. Sprint-specific: manual QA runs from a clean checkout of `41febe7`, not the working tree.

## Exit Criteria

- Vitest suite green at `41febe7`.
- Each of WN-012/013/014/017/018 walked: PASS, PASS WITH NOTES, or FAIL with a bug filed in `production/qa/bugs/BUG-NNNN.md`.
- Retained screenshots on disk for every UI-touching story that passes.
- Sign-off report written to `production/qa/qa-signoff-sprint-002-2026-10-13.md`.
